jei.tactical_loadout.battery: Recharges a night vision device, loose or mounted on a helmet.
jei.tactical_loadout.camo: A full set of one color shrinks mob detection range by %s%% (%s%% while sneaking).
jei.tactical_loadout.detach: To remove an attachment, put the helmet alone in a crafting grid.
jei.tactical_loadout.gas_filter: Refills a gas mask, loose or mounted on a helmet.
jei.tactical_loadout.gas_mask: Attach to any helmet in a crafting grid. Blocks poison, wither and dragon's breath. A filter lasts %s seconds of blocked effects; refill it with a filter.
jei.tactical_loadout.gpnvg18: Four white-phosphor tubes with a wide panoramic view.
jei.tactical_loadout.gpnvg18_green: Four green-phosphor tubes with a wide panoramic view.
jei.tactical_loadout.grenade.decoy_grena: Two seconds after the throw it starts firing fake shots in bursts for %s s, then pops. Monsters without a target walk over to it; sculk sensors and wardens hear it too.
jei.tactical_loadout.grenade.flashbang: Goes off 1.5 s after the throw. The flash is strongest up close and when you look straight at it; anything behind a wall is safe. Players see a white screen, mobs lose their target and slow down.
jei.tactical_loadout.grenade.frag_grenad: Explodes 3 s after the throw. Hurts everything nearby but never breaks blocks.
jei.tactical_loadout.grenade.he_grenade: Explodes 3 s after the throw and destroys blocks like TNT.
jei.tactical_loadout.grenade.impact_gren: Arms after flying 3.5 blocks, then explodes the moment it touches a block or anyone and destroys blocks like TNT. Dropped at your feet it stays safe and goes off after 5 s.
jei.tactical_loadout.grenade.incendiary_: Works like the molotov: on the first floor it lands on, it covers the area in fire for %s s. Smoke puts the fire out and it never spreads into water. If it is still in the air after 2 s, it bursts without fire.
jei.tactical_loadout.grenade.molotov: Shatters on the first floor it lands on and covers it in fire for %s s; it bounces off walls. Anyone in the flames burns. Smoke puts the fire out and it never spreads into water. If it is still in the air after 2 s, it bursts without fire.
jei.tactical_loadout.grenade.smoke_grena: Starts smoking 2 s after the throw. Mobs can't see anyone inside the cloud or through it. A thermal imager still sees living things in the smoke.
jei.tactical_loadout.grenade_throw: Hold right-click to wind up and release to throw: a tap lobs it at your feet, a full second gives the longest throw. Grenades bounce off walls and floors and go off on a timer.
jei.tactical_loadout.heavy: Each heavy piece slows you down by %s%%.
jei.tactical_loadout.mask_fits: The helmet accepts a gas mask.
jei.tactical_loadout.nvg: Attach to a US, Ratnik, SWAT or CT helmet in a crafting grid. Press %s to flip it down for night vision. A battery lasts %s seconds; recharge it with a battery in a crafting grid.
jei.tactical_loadout.nvg_fits: The helmet accepts a night vision device and a gas mask.
jei.tactical_loadout.protection: Bullet protection in the hit zone: light %s%%, medium %s%%, heavy %s%%. Armor-piercing ammo lowers it.
jei.tactical_loadout.protection_single: Bullet protection in the hit zone: %s%%. Armor-piercing ammo lowers it.
jei.tactical_loadout.pvs14: Single green-phosphor tube with a narrow field of view.
jei.tactical_loadout.repair_kit: Put a damaged armor piece and repair kits into an anvil. Each kit restores %s%% durability and costs one level, whatever the tier.
jei.tactical_loadout.thermal: White-hot thermal imager: living creatures in your line of sight glow, even through camouflage.
jei.tactical_loadout.thermal_pano: Four-tube thermal goggles with a wide panoramic view. Made from two thermal monoculars.
jei.tactical_loadout.tripwire_alarm: Place it on the floor across a passage: the wire runs across the direction you face. When anyone walks through it, the tin cans rattle loudly enough to be heard far away. It rearms by itself a moment later.
jei.tactical_loadout.zip_ties: Right-click another player %1$s times in a row to tie them up. A tied player can't move, jump, attack, shoot or use anything. To break free they press the jump key %2$s times; anyone can also cut them loose with shears, %1$s clicks in a row. Respawning frees them too.
jei.tactical_loadout.zones: Zones: helmet covers headshots, chest piece the torso, leggings the legs, boots the feet. Works against TaCZ bullets, arrows and other projectiles, including bullets from gun mods that count as projectiles.
